question.text: In cyclic structure of <math><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></msub></math> if x is number of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> molecules involved in cycle formation and y is the number of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math> hybridised S-atoms. What is the sum of x + y?

solution.text:
x = 3, y = 3
So x + y = 6
